description: The TGA's fees for a listed medicine in Australia (2026–27), added up for a plan: the listing application, the annual charge for each year on the market, variations, requests for new indications, new ingredients by application level (IN1 to IN4, or a range when the level isn't known), assessed listings (AUST L(A)) by category and GMP clearances for overseas factories. Every amount is read from the fee table on takefridayoff.com/guides/tga-approval (and /guides/assessed-listed-medicines) and quoted with its link, with the rules on the annual charge's exemption. TGA fees only: development, evidence and manufacturing are not included.

assessed.description: One entry per assessed listed medicine (AUST L(A)), by application category: L(A)1 for a medicine identical to one already listed as assessed, L(A)2 for an equivalent medicine or one evaluated from a comparable overseas regulator's reports, L(A)3 for a new claim evaluated on its own evidence. Each pays its application and evaluation fees and its own annual charge. Default none.

medicines.description: How many listed medicines (AUST L) to list; each pays the listing application and its own annual charge. Default 1, or 0 when only assessed is given.

new_indications.description: Requests to add a new indication to the TGA's permitted list. Default 0.

new_ingredients.description: One entry per ingredient not yet permitted for listed medicines, by application level: IN1, IN2, IN3 or IN4, or "unknown" for a range. Default none.

overseas_sites.description: Overseas manufacturing sites that need a TGA GMP clearance (per manufacturer, site and sponsor). Default 0.

variations.description: Variations to an existing listing (a change to the product after it is listed). Default 0.

years.description: Financial years of the annual charge to include for each medicine, counting each year it is on the ARTG once it has had turnover. Default 1, the first year it sells.
